messages.text:
I'm sorry, but a rejected request doesn't keep the window open, so I can't refund the cushion now.

Your request (h58-p1) was created on time, on 2026-11-02. A staff member rejected it. The policy says a proposal that a staff member rejected doesn't count for the time limit (refund-policy/v2/window).

The deadline for this order was 2026-11-08 10:00 UTC, and it has passed. A new request is therefore late (refund-policy/v2/window). The policy also doesn't allow exceptions to the time limit (refund-policy/v2/window).

If you want to ask for a person, you can still do that.
